name: What is a real estate investment exit strategy?

mainEntity.name: What is a real estate investment exit strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate investment exit strategy is a pre-defined plan for how an investor intends to sell or otherwise liquidate a property to realize a profit or minimize losses. It outlines the method and timeline for exiting an investment. For example, some investors plan to renovate and sell quickly, while others aim for long-term rental income before eventually selling. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution assists investors in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties with developing and executing these strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: An exit strategy is a pre-defined plan for selling or liquidating a real estate investment to realize a profit or minimize losses.
